quote: Beulah did not just style me for the launch. She built me a wardrobe that walked into every meeting after.
name: Tolulope A.
titleAndOccasion: Director of Operations, GTBank · Office wardrobe build

quote: My wedding pictures look like a magazine. I cried at the second fitting because I finally saw the woman I had been picturing in my head since I was a girl.
name: Chiamaka O.

quote: I returned to work after maternity and walked into a corner office that was not yet mine. Within a month, it was. Half of that was the work. Half was the wardrobe.
name: Adaeze E.
titleAndOccasion: Partner, Lagos law firm · Return to work build

quote: I sent my measurements from London and did the fitting on a video call. The piece arrived and it sat like it had been cut on my body. I still do not know how she did that.
name: Funmi K.
titleAndOccasion: Diaspora client, United Kingdom · Aso ebi build

quote: Five sisters, five bodies, one aso ebi. We arrived and the photographer made us the cover. Beulah dressed the family as one image.
name: Ngozi B.
titleAndOccasion: Sister of the bride, Lagos · Family aso ebi

quote: I wanted pieces that did not shout. Everything she made me is quiet and expensive at the same time. People ask, and I just smile.
name: Halima S.

quote: She talked me out of the dress I thought I wanted and into the one I actually needed. That is the whole service. She sees you before you do.
name: Patience U.

quote: Three years of buying from Beulah. Not one piece has left my wardrobe. That has never happened to me with any other designer.
name: Zainab M.
